EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a strong band at 1660 cm⁻¹ consistent with an alkene C=C stretch, a clear sp2 C–H stretch at 3048 cm⁻¹, and intense aliphatic C–H stretches at 2853/2915/2954 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003), plus a strong CH2 scissoring band at 1445 cm⁻¹ typical of saturated chains. Vinyl C–H deformation/out-of-plane modes near 880–900 and ~1000 cm⁻¹ are suggested by peaks at 881, 856, and 1011 cm⁻¹. These features match an alkenic hydrocarbon like 1-methylcyclopentene (candidate 2) and disfavor carbonyl-rich candidates (which should show an additional strong 1700–1750 cm⁻¹ band not observed), nitro-bearing species (missing the strong ~1520–1560 cm⁻¹ NO₂ band), and purely saturated amides (which should lack the 3048 cm⁻¹ sp2 C–H stretch).
